headline: US Supreme Court limits geofence warrants 6-3, citing privacy rights
summary: The Supreme Court rules authorities need a warrant for geofence location data
details: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that authorities need to obtain a search warrant when asking tech companies for location data of their users, including historical geofence location data. This 6-3 decision cites privacy rights, stating individuals have a reasonable expectation of privacy in their cell-phone location information.

The court's decision centers on a case brought by Chatrie v. United States, who accused the government of using evidence collected by an unconstitutional search warrant. The ruling doesn't stop law enforcement from getting historical cellphone location data, but requires a warrant and probable cause.
The decision may have broad ramifications for privacy rights and law enforcement across the United States. It's not immediately clear how the ruling will affect past court cases.

headline_marked: [[WhatsApp introduces usernames]] for private chats, no phone number needed
headline: WhatsApp introduces usernames for private chats, no phone number needed
summary: Reserve your username now and chat without sharing your phone number. Usernames are launching later this year.
details: WhatsApp is launching usernames, allowing users to chat without sharing their phone numbers. This new feature aims to make the platform 'even more private'.

Users can reserve their usernames starting this week, giving them time to claim a specific handle before the feature officially launches. The username launch will roll out gradually over the coming months.

To reserve a username, users can go to Settings > Account > Username in the latest version of WhatsApp. Individuals and organizations can claim their existing Instagram or Facebook handles to prevent impersonation.

Reserved usernames for famous figures have already been taken to prevent them from being claimed by others. Users can't browse for people using their usernames, so they need to know the exact username to contact them.
